prose: SignSplit, which builds infrastructure for digitally signing datasets, likenesses and creative works, launched with $400 million from W Group at a $1 billion valuation. Founded in 2024 and led by CEO Alessandro Monterosso, it argues that AI and robotics need high-quality human data, that scraped internet data has opaque origins, and that developers will have to pay for data with clear provenance, permissions and usage rights. W Group is a collective of 11 fintech firms focused on blockchain.
highlights: $400M from W Group at a $1B valuation.
Signs datasets, likenesses and creative works for provenance.
Bet: AI developers will pay for data with clear rights.
